quota.notProvided: This account provides no plan quota

login.expired: May have expired; once requests start failing, sign out and sign in again
login.expiresSoon_one: Expires in about {{count}} day; sign in again then
login.expiresSoon_other: Expires in about {{count}} days; sign in again then
login.expiresLater_one: Expires in about {{count}} day, possibly a few days sooner
login.expiresLater_other: Expires in about {{count}} days, possibly a few days sooner
login.noneDetail: Claude Code in the cloud has no account signed in yet
login.tokenDetail: Whether the token works shows in actual requests
login.token: Sign in with a setup token
login.tokenLimits: A setup token may not provide the account’s details, full plan quota or expiry; once it stops working, generate or replace it.
login.signOutToken: Signing out removes the setup token kept on the server and clears Claude Code’s sign-in credentials; session records stay. It doesn’t revoke the token where else it is used.
login.signOutBrowser: After signing out, the official CLI clears the sign-in credentials in the cloud; session records stay. Using it again needs a new sign-in.
login.noToken: No token yet? The server runs the official setup-token and, once you authorize in the browser, saves and uses it.
login.haveToken: Have a token? Paste it below to save it.
login.tokenKept: The token is kept only on the server. The account’s details and full plan quota may not be readable; once the token expires or is revoked, sign out and set it up again.
login.title: Sign in to Claude
login.generating: Generating a setup token on the server; once authorized it is saved automatically and shown once for you to copy.
login.openStep: Open the official authorization page in the browser and sign in.
login.openFailed: Couldn’t open the browser; copy the link.
login.codeStep: Paste the code shown at the end of the authorization page here.

title: Account and quota
intro: The account Claude Code in the cloud is signed in with, and the plan quota read from the official service.

token.saved: Saved on the server and used to sign in.
token.unsaved: The token was generated but not saved on the server yet.
token.once: Shown only here, once; copy it if you need it. The client doesn’t keep it after closing.
